content: Qienxien pse made nie amin winetu moronni uzheghazho, gieghande shuijinni xianli. Huda, ghoni ghughanyi baozose usuru khizhezhi
chenshini geidou dundase daozho. Moron lianmiende aminni mutun wine. 12 yan
alima soune, nie sara 1 hui soune. Mutun lachen gojialai goudaghane.
Kharasanla pse uwo. Chenshide Huda, ghoni ghughanyi baozo wine. Hhei hojila hhei beii
hhei ungiei chanlane. Hhei niere hhelai manlou jiere wine.
Pse xieni uwo, zhula, naranyi gonyi ulie kerene. Ezhan Hudai gon hhelai zhouizho. Hhela chanqi izhi honshan danlane.
Ersa Ireku

Qienxien pse made kieliewo, "Enezighan kielienshi kekao, zhenni wo. Ruhherghala xienzhilai zhughei gojiolughasan Ezhan Huda qienxienne peizhi deigo fashen giene giesan shiqinni hojiladene mejieghawo."
"Uzhe, bi deigo irene. Jien ene shude melieshi kieliesei zunjisanlade fuqi wine!"
Enezighan shiqinshi bi, Yaheiya sonosuzhi chanlasan wo. Bi sonosuzhi chanlase enezighanni made uzheghasan qienxienni kon konde papaladene hhei beiine giese
hhe made kieliewo, "Ulie olune! Chi Hudai beii. Bishi chi, xienzhila, jiushi chii gaijiula, pse ene shude melieshi kieliesei zunjisanlare hhantu hoji danlasan wo."
Hhe pse made kieliewo, "Ene shude melieshi kieliesei bu fenji. Shihou chadashiwo.
Gou witu kun gou wini giegha, zannantu kun zannanni giegha, gou kun gouni giegha, zhiguitu kun zhiguini giegha."
Ersa kieliewo, "Uzhe, bi deigo irene! Jianli ogiku, faiku made wo, jien kun giesanzhe bi kharulune.
Bishi Alafa wo, Emeiga wo. Bishi zui melieshiku wo, zui kuinashiku wo, keitou wo, baraku wo."
Goya jienne waghazhi arughasanlade fuqi wine. Qienli bizhi aminni mutunyi hhende echine, wijiense chenshideye oro shidane.
Nogheila, fashu shuaichen, lon kijiechen, kun alachen, nigiedai beiichen, pse soyuji ghudan kieliekude xiqi bichen, jiani giechenla man chenshi ghadane wo.
"Bi, Ersa jiohuilade oluzhi qienxienne peizhi enezighan shiqinyi tande ganzhen beighane. Bishi Dawudeni houdei wo, eqiemaghaku gieghan hodun wo."
Shenlin shini biereighala, "Ire." giezhi kieliezho. Sonosusanlaye, "Ire." giezhi kielie. Undasusan kunla man ire. Duran bichen kunla man aminni usui belien jienlie.
Bi ene shude melieshi kieliesei soyuji sonosusanlade jingao gieye. Kien ene melieshi kieliesande jiaise Huda ene shude huaisan zeinanni hhei jiere ireghane.
Ene shude melieshi kieliesei kien widaghase Huda ene shude huaisan aminni mutun, pse zhiguitu chenshide hhei bisan guzini widaghane.
Ene shiqinlade ganzhen beisan kieliezho, "Enbene, bi deigo irene." Amine! Ezhan Ersaya, ire!
Ezhan Ersani nenjien shentulare man hhantu bi gie. Amine!
